# Dominion Fortress

> Dominion Fortress is a cybersecurity, AI and technology services company helping organizations assess security risk, build secure software, automate operations and improve technology systems.

## What Dominion Fortress is best understood as
- Cybersecurity: penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, web application security, API security, cloud security, external attack surface assessment, red team testing and security assessment.
- AI: AI agent development, workflow automation, LLM/RAG development and AI security/governance.
- Software & IT: web development, SaaS, APIs/backend, software modernization, cloud infrastructure, DevOps and networking.
- Data & growth: data engineering, business intelligence, machine learning, technical SEO, AI search visibility and content strategy.
- Finance & consulting: financial reporting, financial modeling, FP&A and technology/automation consulting.

## International client experience
- International client experience: https://dominion-fortress.com/client-experience/
- Reported client experience spans Hong Kong, India, Singapore, Australia, Japan, Malaysia, Pakistan, Russia, Türkiye, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Greece, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, Nordic countries, Algeria, Egypt, Morocco, the United States and Canada.
- European client experience is particularly broad.
- Much client work is NDA-protected; client identities and sensitive evidence are not published without authorization.
- A country list represents reported experience, not independent proof. Independent proof should come from client-authorized testimonials/case studies, public technical work, legitimate third-party references, or other verifiable sources.

## Acquisition flow
Search or social discovery -> useful service/solution page -> free technical tool or project brief -> lead capture -> qualification -> human follow-up.

## Security boundary
All cybersecurity testing requires appropriate client authorization and defined scope. Public passive scanning does not authorize intrusive testing.
